Chapter 680 - 680 Repair; Crisis Eliminated!

Chapter 680 - 680 Repair; Crisis Eliminated!

680 Repair; Crisis Eliminated!

At the same time, the fierce chaotic winds whistled continuously like a blade.

The door fragments and chaotic winds shot out at the same time. They were swift and awe-inspiring, making people feel despair.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s entire body burst out with a dazzling golden light, forming a golden wall that blocked everything outside.

The sound waves rippled, and energy surged. The momentum was incomparably terrifying.

“It’s finally broken!”

An earth-shaking voice swept over with terrifying sound waves.

Then, a huge monster that ordinary people could not see clearly appeared in front of them.

Its head was like a tiger, its body was like a cheetah, and its two forked tails were like two twisting pythons.

“Keke, life! So much life force! I’m really lucky this time!

“Huh, how many humans are here? Is this an original planet life form? Then I’ll take you guys as an appetizer!”

As soon as it finished speaking, it opened its mouth and produced a powerful suction force. It was as if it wanted to swallow Lin Fan, as well as the red, green, blue, gray, purple, and black shadows, into its stomach.

The red, green, blue, gray, purple, and black shadows had lost most of their power and were unable to resist the suction force.

Naturally, Lin Fan was not afraid.

He snorted lightly, and the red, green, blue, gray, purple, and black shadows immediately stabilized their bodies.

Lin Fan said indifferently, “Appetizers? I’m afraid that I’ll burst your stomach!”

He raised his hand, and the Star Meteorite Sword appeared.

“Sword One, draw the sword and slash the sky!”

Pulling out his sword, a sharp sword light shot out. It was swift and fierce!

The sword ray collided with the monster, producing a terrifying explosion.

Sword energy flew everywhere, and it was chaos.

When the sword light dissipated, a finger-sized wound appeared on the monster’s stomach.

One sword attack had injured the monster!

The monster seemed to have been insulted and shouted crazily.

“Damn it, damn it, damn it!

“A mere primitive resident actually dares to injure me!”

As soon as the words were uttered, the surroundings seemed to have lost all life force. There was no color, and everything turned gray.

Lin Fan’s expression did not change at all. He quickly shook his wrist.

“Ten Swords!”

“Twenty Swords!”

“Thirty Swords!”

…

One after another, sharp sword lights attacked the monster like lightning.

Loud booms continued, and the world shook.

Gradually, countless sword marks appeared on the monster’s body.

To the naked eye, it looked extremely miserable, as if it had been tortured.

The monster roared at the sky, and the sound waves surged.

He was actually injured by a small native.

This was a great humiliation!

“Destroy! Destroy them all!” the monster shouted.

As soon as he finished speaking, the monster’s mouth suddenly grew bigger and bigger. It shook the sky and covered the sun. It was pitch-black like a huge black hole that wanted to swallow Lin Fan and the Earth into its mouth.

A powerful suction force came rushing over.

Lin Fan’s brows twitched as the power of the five elements revolved within his body, causing his entire body to turn five-colored and extremely dazzling.

At the same time, the pause button seemed to have been pressed as the entire world completely stopped moving.

Only Lin Fan slowly raised his sword and said, “Sixty-six swords!”

As the sword fell, a five-colored pillar of light that seemed to split the sky and earth shot out. It completely illuminated the entire world. Then, it suddenly slashed down from the monster’s head.

The huge monster and the entire chaotic space were split into two, like a piece of paper that had been torn in the middle.

In the next moment, a strong gust of wind blew toward Lin Fan’s face, causing his clothes and the tall red, green, blue, gray, purple, and black shadows to sway.

The monster that was cut in half instantly lost its vitality.

Then, the monster’s corpse turned into two towering mountains and fell straight into the tunnel.

It died just like that!

The red, green, blue, gray, purple, and black shadows could not help but stare blankly at this scene.

Such a powerful existence had died so easily?

They still could not accept it.

However, the mountain-like halves of the corpse, as well as the surging energy that was constantly being absorbed by the Earth, seemed to be telling them that this was the truth.

At this moment, a powerful wind whistled over and directly cut off some of the red shadow’s body.

It could not help but say anxiously, “Lin Fan, the door is broken now. The chaotic winds are coming straight at us. I’m afraid that Earth won’t be able to hold on for much longer. What should we do now?”

Lin Fan did not reply immediately. Instead, he stared at the broken door with his sharp eyes.

After a while, he said, “Then let the door recover!”

Lin Fan raised his hand and gave off an extremely mysterious aura.

It was the power of time!

Then, a very magical scene appeared.

The door that had shattered into pieces flew back.

In the end, it turned into an intact door without a single crack.

The red, green, blue, gray, purple, and black shadows were stunned by this scene.

Their mouths were wide open, and their faces were filled with disbelief.

The red shadow stammered, “This… This… Is the door fixed?”

Lin Fan nodded. “The crisis is over!”

Then, he looked at the huge monster on the ground and said, “After Earth absorbs the energy of the monster, it should enter a higher level. You guys can also recover faster.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he took a step forward and disappeared.

Only the red, green, blue, gray, purple, and black shadows were left. They looked at each other in awe.

…

On the other hand, in the endless starry sky.

An old man with flowery hair suddenly opened his eyes, shooting out dazzling rays of light like two rotating suns.

“Let me see who broke the door I left behind,” the old man said in a low voice.

As soon as he finished speaking, he slowly turned around and looked into the endless void.

It was deep and bright.

Even though he was far away from the starry sky, it could not block his vision at all.

“A low-level Chaos Beast?

“Huh?”

Soon, the old man let out a surprised voice.

“The door has been restored?

“Using the power of time?

“Interesting,” the old man said with a smile. “I didn’t expect that there would be someone who could control the power of time on that small planet. That person should be trained.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he prepared to take a step forward.

At this moment, a loud noise suddenly sounded in the distance.

“Tao Qian, so you’re here. Let’s see where you can run to this time!”

A sharp saber light shot over.

The old man raised his eyebrows and quickly disappeared.
